what_this_is: The wording rules that turn a measure the Hub already computes into one word. Bands are read from the top down: the first band whose floor the number reaches wins. Change a word or a cut-off here and the card follows — no code changes. Every card prints the number beside the word, so the word can always be checked.
who_decides: Alan. These are a first proposal from the 23 Sep deep pass, not a validated calibration.
